## Problem

<!-- What user need does this address? Who is the user? Why is the
     current behavior insufficient? -->

## Proposed solution

<!-- What you'd like to see. Be specific — naming the API method, the

## Alternatives considered

<!-- What other approaches did you think about? Why is the proposed

## Validation criteria

<!-- How will we know the feature works? For data-source additions:

     data quality. For metrics: what's the closed-form definition

     or reference. -->

## Out of scope

<!-- What's explicitly NOT part of this feature? Helps us keep the
     PR focused and avoid scope creep. -->

## Related

<!-- Links to issues, PRs, Discord threads, papers, or competitor
     features that informed the request. -->
